searchText: What latency does the network consider safe? The specification mentions 0.5s as tolerated iirc Hmm, that *is* concerning. I thought the tolerance was on the order of multiple seconds. We can function with multiple days of latency But a latency of 500ms is acceptable in the sense that we don't even penalize peers for it for example This latency constraint affects gossip messages with data from the future. Particularly, blocks, attestations and attestation aggregates from future slots with 500ms tolerance. This parameter isn't related to network synchrony properties in general I think I keep getting kicked from the server a few minutes after joining, although I am able to rejoin. All I've done is post in <#595701895700676644>, and I don't think I broke any rules. Is there some kind of auto-kick bot? Okay I think I figured out how to reproduce the issue. Whenever I close a discord window while still logged in, I'll be kicked from the server. Not sure if it's a bug with discord or something, but it only seems to happen with this server.
